test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Pinky walked 160 m towards north, then she turned right and walks 240 m. Then she turned right and walked 280 m, then she turned left and walked 120 m. Finally, she turned left and walked 120 m. In which direction and how many metres is she from the starting position?

(All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Drawing the figure as per given information,

 
• Pinky walked 160 m towards north, then 
 
• she turned right and walks 240 m. Then 
 
• she turned right and walked 280 m, then 
 
• she turned left and walked 120 m. 
 
• Finally, she turned left and walked 120 m

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8142ac9466d32001e242f264ba44504c0e55a8e2d2fcfa5cd85032e841e47dd4.png] 

here, she is **East, 360 m** from the starting position.

Hence, **'option 4'** is the correct answer.
